subject: Request: shift two platform slots to runtime kernel team (capacity + comp bands)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: TalentWorks Recruiting <recruiting@talentworks.io>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: shift two platform slots to runtime kernel team (capacity + comp bands)

Team —

Quick ask: the runtime kernel squad needs two additional headcount slots this quarter to meet the latency optimization roadmap (KV cache rewrite + kernel fusion work). Rather than increasing net headcount, I propose we reallocate two existing platform-engineer positions (open but budgeted on the platform slate) to runtime kernel.

Why this matters now:
- We have three major customer migrations queued (two Dedicated contracts + one Private pilot) that require sub-20ms median token latency; the kernel rewrite is on the critical path.
- Benchmarks attached show estimated cost savings ~12% per 1M tokens if we finish the KV/cache changes before Q4.

Proposal details (attachments include model):
- Move 2 FTE slots from Platform Team A to Runtime Kernel (effective hire window: next 60 days).
- Role mix: 1 mid-level SWE (L4), 1 senior SWE (L5) focused on low-level performance and CUDA kernel stabilization.
- Compensation bands: use the attached proposed-offer-bands.pdf — we recommend offering at the 55–75 percentile depending on candidate.
- Net budget impact: roughly budget-neutral in FY27 by reprioritizing two open slots and a one-time relocation holdback. See headcount-impact-model.xlsx.

Risks/asks:
- Need finance sign-off on reallocation (Kim).
- Need platform org buy-in (Karthik) to give up the two open slots; we can trade two contractor conversions later in Q3 if needed.
- Recruiting: expedite pipeline for senior latency candidates (TalentWorks CC'd).

If we can get an affirmative today/early next week I can instruct recruiting to accelerate outreach and schedule final interviews with Marissa's team.

Thanks —
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Director, Runtime Performance
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Mills <sarah@financeops.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: shift two platform slots to runtime kernel team (capacity + comp bands)

Mateo —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachables. A couple of quick clarifying questions before Finance can sign off:
1) The "budget-neutral" statement — can you confirm which two platform slots you're pulling from (team and role level)? I need the headcount IDs and current req codes to reflect the shift in our budgeting system.
2) Any expected uplift to run rate (salary + benefits) if we hire toward the 75th percentile for the senior role? We can absorb some one-time cost but recurring increases need Exec approval.

I reviewed the worksheet at a glance — it assumes contractor conversions in Q3 to rebalance. Please annotate the spreadsheet row-level assumption that ties each moved slot to the originating req code (soops, we still need the GH IDs).

Cc'ing Sarah for a fast read; Sarah, if we get the req IDs and updated run-rate estimates by EOW, can Finance greenlight the reallocation subject to exec notification?

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Planning
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, TalentWorks Recruiting <recruiting@talentworks.io>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: shift two platform slots to runtime kernel team (capacity + comp bands)

+1 from Eng leadership — Mateo has been running the microbenchmarks; the kernel initiative is where ops savings and customer SLAs converge. A few operational notes:
- We currently have two strong internal candidates (one SDE II, one SDE III) who've expressed interest in working on runtime performance; we'd prioritize internal transfers to reduce time-to-productivity.
- Interview loop: I can run a targeted loop (perf systems + CUDA review) within 10 business days if recruiting seeds the pipeline.
- SLA: if Platform gives the two slots we commit to a 30-day knowledge transfer window to avoid disruption on ongoing platform roadmaps.

Mateo — attached is a short org-chart snippet and a proposed interview loop. I'll sync with TalentWorks to queue senior outreach this week.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Engineering Manager, Runtime Kernel
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the heads-up. A few points from Platform's side:
- The two open platform slots in question are reqs PL-1187 (platform infra SWE L4) and PL-1192 (platform infra SWE L4). Both are currently unfilled and actively recruiting.
- We're willing to reassign one of those slots immediately, but PL-1192 is earmarked for the new multi-region work for which we have delivery commitments in Q4. If Mateo's team can accept a slightly more junior hire (L3->L4 conversion) for the second slot, we can free it up after a 45-day notice and do a contractor-to-FTE conversion to make up the delta in Q3.
- If Finance requires run-rate numbers, we should model two scenarios: (A) senior at 75th pct for L5, (B) senior at 60th pct. Scenario A requires an exec nod for recurring cost.

I don't want platform delivery to get blocked; happy to work with Mateo on handover cadence (Marissa, your 30-day plan sounds fine).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — after reviewing the attachments and the notes from Karthik, I approve the reallocation with conditions:
1) Move req PL-1187 to Runtime Kernel immediately (effective today).
2) PL-1192 will be released 45 days from today contingent on Platform delivering the multi-region integration milestone; Karthik, please confirm the planned release date and that no customer-facing work is blocked.
3) Finance (Kim) to route any recurring run-rate delta > $18k/year per role to the Exec Compensation Committee; otherwise, recruiting proceed within the 60-day window.

Mateo — please send the annotated headcount-impact-model.xlsx with the req IDs and the two scenarios (A/B) by EOD and cc People Ops so they can update Greenhouse and the payroll forecast. TalentWorks — prioritize senior outreach; internal transfers first.

I'll mark this as approved for hiring ops; formal exec notification considered informational unless Finance flags run-rate exceedance.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
